extDescription.message: Fills in your sign-in forms at the request of the Sésame server installed on your Mac. Nothing ever leaves your computer.

bridgeConnectedHint.message: The Sésame server (sesame_login) will use this extension to fill in forms in this Chrome.

testSuccess.message: Test succeeded: Chrome started the bridge and it responded.

fallbackHint.message: Without a bridge, Sésame falls back to its own dedicated-profile Chrome.

adviceNotFound.message: Native manifest missing: in a terminal, run `sesame install extension --id <ID below>`, then reload the extension.

adviceForbidden.message: This extension's ID is not allowed by the native manifest: rerun `sesame install extension --id <ID below>`, then reload the extension.

adviceExited.message: The bridge stopped (Node not found? another bridge already running?). Check with `sesame doctor`.

notifCodeTitle.message: Sésame is waiting for your code

notifCodeMessage.message: $domain$ is asking for a verification code: type it in the site's tab. Sésame will wait up to $timeout$ s.

bannerWaitCode.message: Sésame is waiting for you to enter the code you received by email, SMS, or app. The sign-in will continue automatically once the site accepts it ($remaining$s left).
